Cyber Monday FAQs

When does the Cyber Monday sale end?

Tonight at 11:59 p.m. ET. It's a one-day deal.

Is Cyber Monday pricing available in store?

No. The 20% off deal is for online orders at prrunandwalk.com only.

Do I need a code?

No. 20% comes off automatically at checkout.

Is anything excluded?

Gift cards and race entries, including the =PR= Race Pass.

Can I return something I bought on Cyber Monday?

Yes. Returns are hassle-free for 30 days.

Do you offer free shipping?

Yes, on all orders over $125.
